subject: paper:mazzone-2013
quote: ADHD subjects revealed lower scores on all self-esteem domains compared to controls.
rationale: Verbatim from the open-access abstract. Case-control evidence that self-esteem is lower across all domains in children/adolescents with ADHD — the content of the mechanism.

subject: paper:cook-2014
quote: Individuals with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) often grow up with negative messages surrounding their abilities and may experience adverse outcomes throughout their lives.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. States the accumulation account — negative messages over development — that frames low self-esteem as built rather than intrinsic.

subject: paper:cook-2014
quote: there is evidence to suggest that ADHD is associated with lower self-esteem in adulthood and that self-esteem difficulties can be remedied, to at least some extent, by psychotherapeutic work.
rationale: Verbatim from the abstract. Systematic-review conclusion of lower self-esteem in adults with ADHD (and its partial remediability).

subject: paper:harpin-2016
quote: Untreated ADHD was associated with poorer long-term self-esteem and social function outcomes compared with non-ADHD controls.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. Long-term systematic-review evidence (127 studies) that untreated ADHD predicts poorer self-esteem outcomes.

subject: paper:harpin-2016
quote: Treatment for ADHD was associated with improvement in outcomes; however, further long-term outcome studies are needed.
rationale: Verbatim from the abstract. Treatment was linked to improvement in most self-esteem outcomes — the modifiability point — with an appropriate caveat about the evidence.
